query: INSERT INTO davpush_subscriptions (id, topic, expiration, push_resource, public_key, public_key_type, auth_secret) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET topic = EXCLUDED.topic, expiration = EXCLUDED.expiration, push_resource = EXCLUDED.push_resource, public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key, public_key_type = EXCLUDED.public_key_type, auth_secret = EXCLUDED.auth_secret
